title: 最大单词长度乘积
summary: 从小写单词数组中选两个没有公共字母的单词，使长度乘积最大。
insight: 把每个单词出现的字母压缩成 26 位掩码，两词无公共字母等价于掩码按位与为零。
pitfalls: 同一单词内重复字母不影响掩码
必须选择两个不同下标
无合法正乘积时返回零

solutions.title: 字母位掩码
solutions.idea: 预处理每词掩码后两两检查交集并更新乘积。

code.java: class Solution { public int maxProduct(String[] words){int[] masks=new int[words.length];for(int i=0;i<words.length;i++)for(char c:words[i].toCharArray())masks[i]|=1<<(c-'a');int answer=0;for(int i=0;i<words.length;i++)for(int j=i+1;j<words.length;j++)if((masks[i]&masks[j])==0)answer=Math.max(answer,words[i].length()*words[j].length());return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxProduct(words:Array<String>):Int{val masks=IntArray(words.size);for(i in words.indices)for(c in words[i])masks[i]=masks[i] or (1 shl (c-'a'));var answer=0;for(i in words.indices)for(j in i+1 until words.size)if(masks[i] and masks[j]==0)answer=maxOf(answer,words[i].length*words[j].length);return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int maxProduct(vector<string>& words){vector<int> masks(words.size());for(int i=0;i<(int)words.size();++i)for(char c:words[i])masks[i]|=1<<(c-'a');int answer=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)words.size();++i)for(int j=i+1;j<(int)words.size();++j)if((masks[i]&masks[j])==0)answer=max(answer,(int)(words[i].size()*words[j].size()));return answer;} };
